source_review.notes: Reviewed current PostgreSQL 18 BRIN, EXPLAIN, index-scanning, reverse-map source, and original implementation record; O'Neil-Quass and O'Neil/O'Neil/Wu bitmap work; LBNL bitmap survey; Lemire-Kaser-Aouiche; and the cited textbook. Seven direct destinations returned HTTP 200 and the IEEE DOI resolver returned HTTP 202. Product behavior is version/current-source scoped.

Checked selected fraction, candidates, matches, false positives/ratio, exact/lossy pages, memory, and range size.
Checked exact candidates, lossy supersets, visible results, and summary possibility as distinct classes.
notation_and_syntax.notes: All min/max comparisons state inclusive range assumptions and explicit NULL/operator-class exceptions.

evidence: Independently recomputed bitmap intersection (1,4) and union (1,2,3,4,5,7).

Re-derived why summary overlap is not sufficient for a row match.
Re-derived AND/OR as intersection/union and NOT as complement relative to a declared universe.
Re-derived compositional soundness of exact inputs, lossification to supersets, conservative summaries, and final recheck.

Reviewed ordered/reverse/random/clustered/backfilled layouts, small/large pages-per-range, stale-wide summaries, unsummarized/desummarized/invalid ranges, and missed autosummarize requests.

Draft validation accepted front matter, section order, ten examples, five exercises/answers, local links, and snippet execution before stopping only for review evidence.
invariant_checking.notes: The model omits compressed storage, SQL/MVCC, memory lossification implementation, persistent pages, WAL, concurrency, and performance.

evidence: Reviewed both min/max rejection cases and their assumptions line by line.
Reviewed exact set-operation and lossification-superset preservation.
Reviewed stale-wider summary safety versus stale-narrow summary danger.
Reviewed all exercise answers for set universe, interval candidates, operator selection, recovery states, and comparative experiment design.
proof_review.notes: No proof of PostgreSQL concurrency/recovery, compression optimality, optimizer choice, or workload dominance is claimed.

evidence: The compositional argument is explicitly a proof sketch with access-method assumptions.
The executable artifact is explicitly a stable finite model with omitted domains.
Persistent bitmap index, PostgreSQL transient Bitmap Index Scan, and BRIN are never conflated.
Audited exact, lossy, consistent, proves, no false negatives, correlated, small, current, and optimal language for scope.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Lossy evidence is consistently described as a candidate superset requiring recheck.

evidence: The standard-library bitmap/summary model executed successfully through the repository verifier.
Independent computation reproduced selected ranges, rechecks, matches, false positives, and the full-scan oracle.
Seven sources returned HTTP 200 and the IEEE resolver HTTP 202.
Performance recommendations require layout, correlation, exact/lossy blocks, rechecks, memory, I/O, maintenance, and p99 evidence.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No live DBMS, persistent bitmap, BRIN page, MVCC snapshot, memory lossification, concurrent maintenance, crash recovery, or benchmark was executed.

conceptual_review.notes: The chapter separates persistent bitmaps, transient bitmap plans, and conservative physical summaries while deriving the exact candidate/recheck contract of each.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed correlation, pages-per-range, outliers, summary variants, unsummarized debt, exact/lossy memory, MVCC/TID identity, WAL/recovery, physical layout, observability, and access-path experiments.

pedagogical_review.notes: The review sheet, executable bitmap/BRIN trace, ten distinct examples, and five exercises progress from set/interval reasoning through crash-safe maintenance and production comparison.

limitations: Internal authoring, primary/official-source, mathematical, bounded executable-model, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed. The chapter does not certify a persistent bitmap, BRIN operator class, summary state, MVCC/TID mapping, optimizer plan, physical correlation, workload result, or production fitness.
